# Flugelsoft Labs — MatsyaSample Assam (NESFIC-D-32)

> Scientifically defensible, repeatable rotating sample survey, digital harvest diaries, sample weighing verification, and confidence-interval estimation for Assam pond and tank aquaculture (NESFIC-D-32, Fishery Department, Government of Assam).

## Lead Applicant & Organization
- **Lead Applicant**: Kalyanjit Hatibaruah
- **Lead Entity**: Flugelsoft Labs
- **Region**: Assam, India (IN-AS)
- **Challenge**: North East Seva First Innovation Challenge (NESFIC) 2026 — NESFIC-D-32
- **Challenge Owner**: Fishery Department • Government of Assam / Directorate of Fisheries
- **Live URL**: https://flugelsoft-matsyasample.pages.dev/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/flugelsoft-01/nesfic-d32-pond-tank-survey

## Key Routes (SEO & GEO Friendly)
- `/` or `/assam-pond-tank-sample-survey-ledger` — Rotating Sample Frame & Pond/Tank Survey Ledger (https://flugelsoft-matsyasample.pages.dev/)
- `/survey-simulator` or `/stratified-sampling-confidence-interval-simulator` — Interactive Stratified Sampling & Confidence Interval Simulator (https://flugelsoft-matsyasample.pages.dev/survey-simulator)
- `/district-estimates` or `/assam-aquaculture-production-estimates-audit` — District & State Production Estimates with 95% Confidence Intervals & Audit Export (https://flugelsoft-matsyasample.pages.dev/district-estimates)
- `/proposal` or `/nesfic-d32-aquaculture-survey-proposal` — Complete 12-Section NESFIC-D-32 Proposal & Downloadable PDFs (https://flugelsoft-matsyasample.pages.dev/proposal)
- `/tutorial` or `/matsyasample-assam-tutorial` — Comprehensive Tutorial & Guide on statistical sampling, harvest diaries, and confidence intervals (https://flugelsoft-matsyasample.pages.dev/tutorial)

## Indicative Pilot & Statewide Districts (Assam, India)
- **Nagaon (26.3480° N, 92.6838° E):** High-production freshwater pond and tank aquaculture district
- **Kamrup (26.1445° N, 91.7362° E):** Medium-intensity peri-urban & rural pond aquaculture district
- **Dima Hasao (25.1667° N, 93.0167° E):** Geographically distinct hill-district tank & pond cluster
- **Cachar (24.8333° N, 92.7789° E):** Barak Valley floodplain pond & tank cluster
- **Barpeta (26.3229° N, 91.0063° E):** Lower Assam high-density rural aquaculture belt
